desktop_enable_help: Control the Windows Onmyoji client. Save and restart the script to apply.
game_path_help: Enter the directory containing bin/onmyoji.exe, or leave blank to search automatically.
profile_dir_help: Use a separate directory per instance to keep account data separate. Leave blank to use the default account data.
window_pos_help: Enter x,y (for example, 0,0), or leave blank to keep the current position.
window_title_help: Give this instance a distinct taskbar title, or leave blank to keep the game's title.
launch_instance_help: Enable desktop mode and save your settings before launching the game.
desktop_launch_failed: Could not launch the desktop client. Check the OAS backend log.
restart_when_window_exists: Force restart if a window is open
restart_when_window_exists_help: Allow the Restart task to close and relaunch an existing desktop client.
dungeon_lock_team_help: Control the lineup lock on the dungeon page. Team presets can still be applied when locked.
enable_dungeon_loadout_help: Solo players and leaders apply presets on the dungeon page; members equip souls from the Shikigami Records. In co-op, both apply the preset again on the first battle's Ready screen, with a 20-second timeout.
enable_sougenbi_loadout_help: Apply the team preset and souls once per run on the Sougenbi dungeon page.
enable_goryou_loadout_help: Apply the team preset and souls once per run on the selected Goryou boss page before the first challenge.
enable_netherworld_loadout_help: Apply the team preset and souls from Team Preset at the lower left of the Netherworld page before the first challenge.
enable_kirin_loadout_help: Apply the team preset and souls from Team Preset at the bottom of the Kirin page before the first challenge.
battle_bondling_loadout_help: Apply the team preset and souls on the Search or Capture page before battle. Reapply when switching between them. Party members equip souls from the Shikigami Records.
enable_area_boss_loadout_help: Apply the team preset and souls from Team Preset on the right of the first Area Boss detail page you challenge each run.
dungeon_preset_help: Enter group number,team number (e.g. 1,2) or group name,team name (read with OCR). Leave blank or enter -1,-1 to keep the current team.
raid_lock_team_help: Lock the lineup on the raid page. Preset switching still works with the lineup locked.
enable_raid_loadout_help: Apply the team and its souls from Team Preset on the right of the raid page before battle.
raid_preset_help: Enter group number,team number (e.g. 1,2) or group name,team name (read with OCR). Leave blank or enter -1,-1 to keep the current team.
demon_retreat_lock_team_help: Skip manually clicking Ready for the first round. Preset switching on the Demon Retreat page still works.
demon_retreat_switch_loadout_help: Apply the team and its souls from Team Preset at the bottom of the Demon Retreat page before battle.
demon_retreat_preset_help: Enter group number,team number (e.g. 3,2) or group name,team name (read with OCR). Leave blank or enter -1,-1 to keep the current team.
